text:
sasha: FYI seeing weird KV cache page metadata layout on H100 after long-seq runs. noncontig pages show up and not evicted. reproducer attached.

martin: hmm. does it only happen on H100? logs?

sasha: repro on h100 and rtx6000 but not consistently on a100. ran mem-prof with --kv-pager=async --page-size=64k. output snippet:
```
[kv_pager] alloc_page id=0x7f... flags=0x3 mapped=0
[kv_pager] mark_noncontig pidx=1024 len=3
[kv_pager] async_evict queued=1 status=OK
[kv_pager] page_table: hole at 0x1f000
```

martin: that mark_noncontig line looks wrong. page len=3? should be single page entries.

olivia: on a100 we saw different timing: async_evict completes before reuse window triggers. maybe race between reuse and eviction.

kevin: hypothesis: async eviction marks PTEs stale but doesn't fold into sparse index before reuse; schedule on GPU-side callback can reorder. could be kernel selection issue where small kernels run inline and skip PTE sync.

sasha: repro script:
```
PYTHONPATH=./tools python -m repro.run --model 70b --ctx 65k --iter 300 --kv-pager async --page-size 64k
```

martin: can you attach pmap snapshot and the memstats trace? run with --trace-kv

sasha: uploaded trace to /mnt/artifacts/1871234567/trace.zip

infra-bot: CI job kvcache-repro-1871234567 failed: oom on h100-3, artifacts at gs://redwood-ci/artifacts/1871234567 :warning:

kevin: quick hack to log pte states around eviction:
```
for p in pages:
  if p.metadata & NONCONTIG:
    log(p.idx, p.metadata, p.owner)
```

olivia: next steps: 1) run with sync-before-evict patch 2) try kernel forcing path (disable tiny-kernel optimization) 3) run long-run 10k tokens on h100

sasha: noted. i'll try sync patch and post results. thanks :thumbsup:

martin: if sync fixes it, we'll need targeted unit test simulating interleaved reuse + async-evict on both cuda and rocm

sasha: ack, starting runs now, will update later.
